HTTP adapter is internal to the
UML Package diagram: the five direct packages are the actual Spring Modulith module
bases. Adapter sub-packages remain inside their owning module. Detailed hexagonal
Adapter/Strategy/Facade roles are shown in the component/port views rather than by
inventing package-per-layer namespaces that do not exist in the implementation.
